<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N – H – X)/2 and the molecular formula C14H24O3Cl (C=14, H=24, N=0, X=1), the calculation gives DBE = (28 + 2 – 24 – 1)/2 = 5/2 = 2.5. Since DBE must be an integer, we take the nearest whole number, which is 2.</thought>
<final_answer>2</final_answer>
